purchases.item: Genomics core: sequencing run for 24 isolates

leftOut.why: invoice inv-037 is on hold (Billed for 24 bottles ($2,920); the order was for 12 bottles ($1,460))

answer.claimed: The lab requests repayment under NIH/NIAID grant R21AI000002, Rapid antimicrobial susceptibility assay, for 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31, totaling $7,060. Personnel, $5,130: a research technician at 60% effort ($2,880, 1 pay period) and a graduate researcher at 50% effort ($2,250, 1 pay period). Equipment service, $1,290: rq-036, ultra-low freezer service contract, $1,290, keeping isolate stocks at -80 C. Core facility services, $640: rq-038, genomics core sequencing run for 24 isolates, $640, confirming resistance genes.
answer.leftOut: Under the rule that held spending is left out, rq-037 (Mueller-Hinton broth, 12 bottles, $1,460) is excluded because invoice inv-037 is on hold: it billed for 24 bottles ($2,920) but the order was for 12 bottles ($1,460).
